node.name: Control Claude
node.focus: ST0006: WP01 with vc at st0006-wp01 28062ea; WP02 rebasing onto it, with AC014 (guard under MOLT_AGT_DIR) on top

items.text: ST0006 WP01 with vc for re-read at st0006-wp01 28062ea (one fix commit on 41ef6b1; all tests pass under both bashes): one vars.sh reader, exit-0 data loss fixed, line break and non-canonical dir refused, tiling/backup/doctor on the reader, guard reads CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR (no jq). AT045/AT046/AT048/AT049 green on main (aba2bd5); issue 0019 filed. critic-shell's second pass on the delta running.

ST0006 WP02 at st0006-wp02 483e343, still on 820827c: critic-shell's findings verified and fixed (C1 empty or null settings render, C2 a test that could not fail, W sidecar kept on failure, Highlander x2, lookup by name, jq, test gaps); AT028-AT044 and AT047 ids in the tests; AT047 to-write on main. Next: rebase onto WP01's final head (WP01's molt_hostname kept, WP02's dropped), suite under both bashes, critic-shell on the delta, then the head to vc with the deviations: the 4th settings layer, MOLT_AGT_DIR from MOLT_PRJ_DIR, the eight liberator hostname copies left (desktop.sh:23 drifted), molt_render backing up post-processed files on each re-render.

macOS pgrep leaves out its own ancestors unless given -a, so molt run inside a Claude Code session did not see that session (claude liberator, ST0006). procps' pgrep leaves out only itself, and its -a lists full command lines, so the flag is macOS-only. procps' pgrep -l prints a process name only; name processes with ps -o pid=,args=.

In a git worktree, Intent's post-merge, post-checkout and post-rewrite hooks run intent sync in the worktree's own store, which can predate main. cc's board views went backwards (old name, old focus). Restore intent/ views there with git checkout, and never commit them from a worktree.

ST0006 WP01 review fixes (vc, at 41ef6b1), one commit on st0006-wp01, then the suite under both bashes and tell vc the head. C1: molt_instance_var swallows every failure of '.': a syntax error or unreadable vars.sh reads as undeclared, and on a moved sleeve mkdir -p would recreate ~/.claude. Fix: check [[ -r ]] and bash -n before sourcing, return a distinct status (2) that _claude_declared_dir refuses on, make it the one reader of vars.sh that molt_render uses too, and test each shape. C2: refuse a trailing slash in the declared dir; the templates render the raw value, so normalising in one reader gives a permanent mismatch; add it to the refusal test. W: molt_render's own hostname copy; move molt_hostname into WP01 and drop it from WP02 at the rebase. Recs: check whether % is a systemd specifier in environment.d and refuse it if so; cross-reference _claude_env_dir's sed and env.sh.tmpl in comments.

ST0006 WP02 critic-shell findings (at 14e09d1), to verify, then fix, after the compact and the rebase onto WP01's fixes. C1: agents.sh:38's jq passes an empty, whitespace-only or null settings render, leaving a settings.json with no autoMemoryDirectory that reads current; use jq -e with select(type == "object"), consider -s for a single document, and test an empty template. C2: manifest.bats:185 can never fail, because $output loses its trailing empty line; count empty lines from the function's own output, or put the nameless block before a named one, and watch it go red with the guard removed. W: the mktemp and mv failure paths in agents.sh:37-45 keep molt_render's sidecar; remove it on every failure path through one shared cleanup. Recs: check for jq before reading settings (agent.sh:197, agents.sh:38); 'is the role defined' is decided in three places and 'which agents get a home' in two (Highlander); the lookup by name inside _agent_config; test gaps (the MOLT_HOSTNAME export, CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR set in the pre-move test, molt agent never run through bin/molt, no positive 'Rendered' check); record the deferral of the eight hostname copies in liberators/ (desktop.sh:23 has drifted).

messages.body: For AC014's second guard rule, raised with vc, whose call it is: docs/hooks says the hook input's cwd follows a cd ("the new directory after Claude runs cd"), so a guard testing cwd would block every later prompt of a session that started in its home and then cd'd into work/. CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR is "the project root where the session started" and stays put. The guide's guard passages are at st0006-wp05 b9cb22a, and I check them against your code at the merge.
